units.source_text: 只此寥寥数字，而笔迹十分高超优美。

en.t: There were only these few words, yet the handwriting was extraordinarily refined and beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏大将想：“能稍加些哀愁之趣，便更好了。”

en.t: General Genji thought, "If only it had a little more touch of melancholy, it would be even better."

units.source_text: 此时朝雾弥漫，晨景异常动人。

en.t: By then the morning mist had spread everywhere, and the dawn scene was unusually moving.

units.source_text: 源氏大将仰望天空，自言自语地吟道：

en.t: General Genji looked up at the sky and murmured a poem to himself:
